source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-04: Bandits of Immenwood

items.name: Special (Note)
items.text: The reefclaws follow the call of the scale, but its siren song affects aquatic aberrations differently than normal animals. While in pursuit of the scale, the reefclaws gain the amphibious trait, gain a +5-foot item bonus to their Speed, and are Sickened 2 (all adjustments already included in their stat block). The reefclaws cannot remove these conditions while within a half mile of the scale.

items.name: Death Frenzy
items.text:
Trigger The reefclaw is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

---

Effect The reefclaw makes a claw Strike before dying.

items.name: Reefclaw Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 15 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 1(1 round),

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 2(1 round).
